body:
## Summary

npm `latest` still serves 0.3.2, whose shell/JavaScript launcher fails before it can display `--version` or `--help`. The working Bun launcher is already on `main`; this PR prepares its 0.4.0 release and verifies the executable that consumers actually install.

- Add `bun run test:package`: pack the package, install the tarball into a clean temporary npm prefix, and invoke both flags through the generated bin link from outside the checkout. Verify the exact version and expected help options, then clean up the installation.
- Run the artifact smoke test in a Linux PR/main CI job and gate automatic releases on it. Install Bun in both publishing jobs, which previously set up only Node.js despite invoking Bun during versioning.
- Repeat the packed-artifact test after release versioning. Propagate nonzero publish exits and require the exact npm version, matching `latest` tag, and successful execution of a fresh registry installation before setting publication outputs or creating a GitHub release. Apply the same checks to already-published reruns, with bounded retries for registry propagation.
- Extend the existing minor changeset to include the pending Bun-only launcher fix and release safeguards. Changesets confirms the next version is **0.4.0**; Bun >=1.2.0 remains required.

## Reproduction and regression coverage

```sh
bun experiments/reproduce-npm-launcher.mjs
bun scripts/package-smoke-test.mjs gh-load-issue@0.3.2
```

The reproduction installs the historical artifact into an isolated prefix and asserts that both commands fail. The smoke test exits nonzero for that artifact with `//: Permission denied`, `import: not found`, and `Syntax error: "(" unexpected`. Running `bun run test:package` against this branch instead passes both commands through the installed bin link.

`tests/test-npm-release.test.mjs` adds 11 automated tests covering absent registry versions, stale `latest`, propagation retries, broken installed executables, publish failures, successful publication, registry connection errors, and already-published reruns. Publication success cannot be inferred solely from a zero exit status.

## Validation

- [x] `bun test` — 71 passed, including existing CLI/library integration tests.
- [x] `node --test tests/test-npm-release.test.mjs` — 11 passed with the release script's Node runtime.
- [x] `bun run test:package` — packed artifact installs and both commands pass.
- [x] `bun run check` — lint, formatting, file size, and duplication checks pass.
- [x] `bun scripts/validate-changeset.mjs` — one valid minor changeset.
- [x] Changesets release plan — 0.3.2 → 0.4.0.
- [x] Historical npm 0.3.2 fails the new installed-artifact check.
- [x] [GitHub Actions on 026e7b1](https://github.com/link-foundation/gh-load-issue/actions/runs/37561308878) — all six checks pass, including Linux/macOS/Windows tests and the installed npm package smoke test.

Publication remains a post-merge action of the existing release workflow. This PR does not claim that the npm registry has already advanced; the workflow will check that postcondition when it publishes.

Fixes #18
